label: Lifelong intellectual partnership; Beauvoir founded feminist existentialism
description: Simone de Beauvoir adopted Jean-Paul Sartre's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Jean-Paul Sartre's perspective to Simone de Beauvoir's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis era.

label: Formulated and introduced Existence Precedes Essence & Bad Faith
description: Jean-Paul Sartre formulated and introduced the concept of "Existence Precedes Essence & Bad Faith", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Jean-Paul Sartre's canonical writings.
